title: Karol G 2026: Here’s Where to Get Last-Minute Tickets to the Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour Online
summary: Starting on July 24, the Colombian singer/songwriter hits the road with tour dates across the United States.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Latin music singer/songwriter Karol G hits the road this summer with the Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour, which is scheduled to begin in the United States on Friday (July 24) at Soldier Field in Chicago. The U.S. leg of the tour ends Oct. 15 at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas, before she travels to Mexico, South America and Europe for the rest of 2026 and into 2027 .

Shop Karol G Tickets at Ticketmaster

The tour is in support of her latest album, Tropicoqueta from 2025. Additionally, there’s a rotating lineup of recording artists who are set to support, including Elena Rose , Becky G and Greeicy.

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find last-minute Karol G tickets online is through third-party sites, including StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.
